title_zh: 调整奇幻舞台剧的战斗场面

scenario.label_zh: 排练奇幻舞台战斗场景
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清虚构角色的情境并确定以音效表现台外战斗时的入场方式

context_zh: 社区剧团排练完全虚构的奇幻故事，讨论的是舞台表现而非真实军事行动。
author: author-phase03-a

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: I have never had to act frightened before. What has my character just seen?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: In this world, the queen's army guards the floating city. Your character has seen the enemy ships arrive.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Does the attack happen on stage?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: No. The audience hears a bell and a distant crash. Then you enter with the warning.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: So I should look back toward the sound before I speak?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Yes. Take a moment to catch your breath, then deliver the first line.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Let us try it with the bell. I think I understand the entrance now.

targets.sense_zh: 表演出某种情绪或状态
